sql.scoped:
SELECT steward_delivery_intents.id, steward_delivery_intents.generation_id, steward_delivery_intents.space_id, steward_delivery_intents.intent_key, steward_delivery_intents.kind, steward_delivery_intents.payload_json, steward_delivery_intents.effect_fingerprint, steward_delivery_intents.status, steward_delivery_intents.attempt, steward_delivery_intents.lease_owner, steward_delivery_intents.lease_until, steward_delivery_intents.available_at, steward_delivery_intents.error_code, steward_delivery_intents.created_at, steward_delivery_intents.updated_at 
FROM steward_delivery_intents JOIN steward_generations ON steward_generations.id = steward_delivery_intents.generation_id 
WHERE steward_generations.status = 'published' AND steward_delivery_intents.status = 'pending' AND steward_delivery_intents.kind != 'inferred_overlay' AND (steward_delivery_intents.available_at IS NULL OR steward_delivery_intents.available_at <= '2026-09-14 14:00:00.000000') AND (steward_delivery_intents.lease_until IS NULL OR steward_delivery_intents.lease_until <= '2026-09-14 14:00:00.000000') AND (steward_delivery_intents.kind != 'assist' OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT steward_delivery_intents_1.id 
FROM steward_delivery_intents AS steward_delivery_intents_1 
WHERE steward_delivery_intents_1.generation_id = steward_delivery_intents.generation_id AND steward_delivery_intents_1.kind = 'terminology' AND (steward_delivery_intents_1.status = 'pending' OR steward_delivery_intents_1.status = 'failed' AND JSON_EXTRACT(steward_delivery_intents_1.payload_json, '$."phase"') IN ('refresh', 'complete'))))) AND (steward_delivery_intents.kind != 'terminology' OR JSON_EXTRACT(steward_delivery_intents.payload_json, '$."phase"') != 'refresh' OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT steward_delivery_intents_1.id 
FROM steward_delivery_intents AS steward_delivery_intents_1 
WHERE steward_delivery_intents_1.generation_id = steward_delivery_intents.generation_id AND steward_delivery_intents_1.kind = 'terminology' AND JSON_EXTRACT(steward_delivery_intents_1.payload_json, '$."phase"') = 'target' AND steward_delivery_intents_1.status = 'pending'))) AND (steward_delivery_intents.kind != 'terminology' OR JSON_EXTRACT(steward_delivery_intents.payload_json, '$."phase"') != 'complete' OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT steward_delivery_intents_1.id 
FROM steward_delivery_intents AS steward_delivery_intents_1 
WHERE steward_delivery_intents_1.generation_id = steward_delivery_intents.generation_id AND steward_delivery_intents_1.kind = 'terminology' AND steward_delivery_intents_1.intent_key != 'terminology:complete' AND (steward_delivery_intents_1.status = 'pending' OR steward_delivery_intents_1.status = 'failed' AND JSON_EXTRACT(steward_delivery_intents_1.payload_json, '$."phase"') = 'refresh')))) AND steward_delivery_intents.generation_id = 1 ORDER BY steward_delivery_intents.id
 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0
